generation.sampleRule: Global cell centre (column*240+x+0.5, row*240+y+0.5); one global raster sliced without seam repaint.
generation.nativeCoordinates: Wall metre endpoints = global east/south - sectorOrigin - 0.5; tile indices remain integer cells.
generation.sidewalkPresence: Mapped sidewalk=yes/both/left/right only; separate footways retain their source geometry.
generation.waterPolicy: Fill complete source polygons first; land cover never creates land in water. Only mapped building footprints, bridges or wooden-surface paths can provide source-backed support over water.

vegetation.policy: Mapped tree cell proxies plus declared seeded broadleaf/reed scatter on mapped land vegetation, excluding all mapped sports pitches; not surveyed species or individual tree positions.

generation.sportsSurfaces: Mapped pitch polygons exclude procedural greenery; tennis/pickleball use a declared existing asphalt proxy unless a supported source surface tag is present. No invented court lines or current inventory claim.

buildingDefaults.policy: Native-kit closed exterior proxies on one-metre integer-edge plans; geographic outlines retained separately; courtyard holes and shared party wall relationships retained; no invented entrances/interiors.
buildingDefaults.evidence: Storeys: survey > building:levels tag > county STORIES > lidar eave > default. Material: survey > building:material tag > county wall code > default. Each building records its sources in nativeProxy; county/lidar storey disagreements are kept for a survey.

Separate wooden boardwalk reaches farther south to town y1612.463; do not conflate it with the named Parkway endpoint.

coverageNotes: The full rectangle preserves the western Johns Avenue segment near town y1647. Its eastern South Highland junction near y1752 lies outside this1680m-deep cropped downtown project.
The eastern supplement closes the original API query's approximately11m shortfall beyond town x1429; all raw snapshots remain unchanged and attributed.

Regional route/admin relations and four residential land-use relations can have members outside the local query. They are not complete local physical geometry; retain diagnostics and do not fill unknown holes.
limitations: Geographic map-authoring source, not a deployed Farmyard mission or a property survey.
Flat terrain. Storeys and wall materials follow recorded evidence (nativeProxy sources) as whole native-kit storeys, not measured wall heights; no interiors or entrances are inferred.
Building outlines are deliberately generalized to cardinal integer tile edges; original geographic outlines remain in geographicGeometry and raw source snapshots.
The former depot is relocated approximately6.2m to preserve its proportions while clearing the original streets; other fitting changes are recorded in authored-buildings.json.
Native wall butt joints and per-run texture phases retain the workshop's existing limits; curved decorative parts and the lighthouse remain curved.
Water-only sectors remain complete in the atlas/source but the existing four-start/one-exit native validator refuses them.
Road widths, sidewalk widths, bridge/steps heights and seeded vegetation are declared authoring approximations, not measurements.
No suggested future roads are painted; no enemies or gameplay objectives are authored.
